# Section

`layout/section` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

A full-width section that holds any content components in a single column. The general-purpose building block.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Constrained to the email width, on the surface color.
- **full-width**: Background color runs edge to edge on wide screens. Sets `width: full`, `background: @colors.background`.
- **tinted**: Sits on the page background color for a subtle band. Sets `background: @colors.background`.
- **card**: Bordered, rounded card look taken from the theme. Sets `background: @theme.card.background`, `border: @theme.card.borderWidth solid @theme.card.border`, `radius: @theme.card.radius`, `shadow: @theme.card.shadow`, `padding: @theme.card.padding`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `width` | one of `constrained`, `full` | `"constrained"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"0"` |
| `border` | text | `"none"` |
| `radius` | length | `"0"` |
| `shadow` | one of `none`, `small`, `medium`, `large` | `"none"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background and padding honored. Border radius and shadows are ignored. | Fine. | Swaps to the dark surface when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/section', {
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "content/heading",
      "data": {
        "text": "Free returns, always"
      },
      "settings": {
        "level": "h2"
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "Not the right fit? Send it back within 60 days and we will refund you in full, no questions asked."
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/button",
      "data": {
        "label": "Read our returns policy",
        "href": "https://example.com/pages/returns"
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json

  "data": {
    "content": [
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {

        }
```
